mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 82 degrees by the Verona Public Library with a full moon overhead and an elevated AQI of 57. We expect an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.
The city has a new rain barrel rebate program offering up to 30 dollars per 35-gallon barrel, and don't forget that voting for our new I Voted sticker design contest is open online until August 7.
There is plenty to do today, including yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at The Bogey Factory, while tomorrow we can look forward to Concerts in the Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
Regarding recent activity, on Wednesday, July 22, two juveniles were cited by the Verona Police Department for operating their e-motos on Lincoln Street.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and you can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM and the Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
